toolsPreview.name: whoami
toolsPreview.description: Identify the calling Eodly API key: the organization it belongs to and the scopes it holds.

toolsPreview.name: list_reports
toolsPreview.description: List recent end-of-day reports for the key's organization, most recent first. Each report summarizes who shipped, who is silent, and who is slipping. Requires the reports:read scope.

toolsPreview.name: get_report
toolsPreview.description: Get the full structured content of one end-of-day report by id (KPI status, shipped, silent, slipping, blockers). Requires the reports:read scope.

toolsPreview.name: list_team
toolsPreview.description: List the team roster for the key's organization (name, role, department, active). Personal contact details are omitted. Requires the team:read scope.
